name: chemwand
description: Tell Claude what to draw, get an editable ChemDraw (CDXML) file.
long_description: ChemWand turns plain-language requests into publication-style chemistry figures saved as CDXML, the native editable format of ChemDraw: single structures, reaction schemes, multi-step routes, substrate-scope tables, catalytic cycles and radial figures. Every structure is checked by InChI round-trip before the file is written. Figures are saved to ~/chemwand_figures and opened in ChemDraw. Runs on your own computer; the only network call is the optional PubChem lookup by compound name.
